rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: src/components/Header.tsx onAuthStateChanged listener unconditionally called clearCart(true) every time a Firebase user appeared, including when the user was JUST signing up from guest mode mid-checkout. That wiped the cart immediately after handleEpointCheckout's signUpAndCreateUser succeeded, so the next render of /cart saw items.length===0 and showed the 'Səbətiniz boşdur' screen — the customer never reached Epoint. Fix: gate clearCart on `previousRole && previousRole !== newRole` so the cart is only cleared when an already-logged-in role transitions to a different role (e.g. b2b→customer). Guest→customer (previousRole=null) now preserves the local cart as expected, and registration + order creation + inline Epoint render all proceed normally.
